3745static struct mem_cgroup *mem_cgroup_alloc(struct mem_cgroup *parent)
3746{
3747 struct memcg_vmstats_percpu *statc;
3748 struct memcg_vmstats_percpu __percpu *pstatc_pcpu;
3749 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
3750 int node, cpu;
3751 int __maybe_unused i;
3752 long error;
3753
3754 memcg = kmem_cache_zalloc(memcg_cachep, GFP_KERNEL);
3755 if (!memcg)
3756 return ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM);
3757
3758 error = xa_alloc(&mem_cgroup_private_ids, &memcg->id.id, NULL,
3759 XA_LIMIT(1, MEM_CGROUP_ID_MAX), GFP_KERNEL);
3760 if (error)
3761 goto fail;
3762 error = -ENOMEM;
3763
3764 memcg->vmstats = kzalloc_obj(struct memcg_vmstats, GFP_KERNEL_ACCOUNT);
3765 if (!memcg->vmstats)
3766 goto fail;
3767
3768 memcg->vmstats_percpu = alloc_percpu_gfp(struct memcg_vmstats_percpu,
3769 GFP_KERNEL_ACCOUNT);
3770 if (!memcg->vmstats_percpu)
3771 goto fail;
3772
3773 if (!memcg1_alloc_events(memcg))
3774 goto fail;
3775
3776 for_each_possible_cpu(cpu) {
3777 if (parent)
3778 pstatc_pcpu = parent->vmstats_percpu;
3779 statc = per_cpu_ptr(memcg->vmstats_percpu, cpu);
3780 statc->parent_pcpu = parent ? pstatc_pcpu : NULL;
3781 statc->vmstats = memcg->vmstats;
3782 }
3783
3784 for_each_node(node)
3785 if (!alloc_mem_cgroup_per_node_info(memcg, node))
3786 goto fail;
3787
3788 if (memcg_wb_domain_init(memcg, GFP_KERNEL))
3789 goto fail;
3790
3791 INIT_WORK(&memcg->high_work, high_work_func);
3792 vmpressure_init(&memcg->vmpressure);
3793 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&memcg->memory_peaks);
3794 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&memcg->swap_peaks);
3795 spin_lock_init(&memcg->peaks_lock);
3796 memcg->socket_pressure = get_jiffies_64();
3797#if BITS_PER_LONG < 64
3798 seqlock_init(&memcg->socket_pressure_seqlock);
3799#endif
3800 memcg1_memcg_init(memcg);
3801 memcg->kmemcg_id = -1;
3802 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&memcg->objcg_list);
3803#ifdef CONFIG_CGROUP_WRITEBACK
3804 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&memcg->cgwb_list);
3805 for (i = 0; i < MEMCG_CGWB_FRN_CNT; i++)
3806 memcg->cgwb_frn[i].done =
3807 __WB_COMPLETION_INIT(&memcg_cgwb_frn_waitq);
3808#endif
3809#ifdef CONFIG_TRANSPARENT_HUGEPAGE
3810 spin_lock_init(&memcg->deferred_split_queue.split_queue_lock);
3811 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&memcg->deferred_split_queue.split_queue);
3812 memcg->deferred_split_queue.split_queue_len = 0;
3813#endif
3814 lru_gen_init_memcg(memcg);
3815 return memcg;
3816fail:
3817 mem_cgroup_private_id_remove(memcg);
3818 __mem_cgroup_free(memcg);
3819 return ERR_PTR(error);
3820}

3822static struct cgroup_subsys_state * __ref
3823mem_cgroup_css_alloc(struct cgroup_subsys_state *parent_css)
3824{
3825 struct mem_cgroup *parent = mem_cgroup_from_css(parent_css);
3826 struct mem_cgroup *memcg, *old_memcg;
3827 bool memcg_on_dfl = cgroup_subsys_on_dfl(memory_cgrp_subsys);
3828
3829 old_memcg = set_active_memcg(parent);
3830 memcg = mem_cgroup_alloc(parent);
3831 set_active_memcg(old_memcg);
3832 if (IS_ERR(memcg))
3833 return ERR_CAST(memcg);
3834
3835 page_counter_set_high(&memcg->memory, PAGE_COUNTER_MAX);
3836 memcg1_soft_limit_reset(memcg);
3837#ifdef CONFIG_ZSWAP
3838 memcg->zswap_max = PAGE_COUNTER_MAX;
3839 WRITE_ONCE(memcg->zswap_writeback, true);
3840#endif
3841 page_counter_set_high(&memcg->swap, PAGE_COUNTER_MAX);
3842 if (parent) {
3843 WRITE_ONCE(memcg->swappiness, mem_cgroup_swappiness(parent));
3844
3845 page_counter_init(&memcg->memory, &parent->memory, memcg_on_dfl);
3846 page_counter_init(&memcg->swap, &parent->swap, false);
3847#ifdef CONFIG_MEMCG_V1
3848 memcg->memory.track_failcnt = !memcg_on_dfl;
3849 WRITE_ONCE(memcg->oom_kill_disable, READ_ONCE(parent->oom_kill_disable));
3850 page_counter_init(&memcg->kmem, &parent->kmem, false);
3851 page_counter_init(&memcg->tcpmem, &parent->tcpmem, false);
3852#endif
3853 } else {
3854 init_memcg_stats();
3855 init_memcg_events();
3856 page_counter_init(&memcg->memory, NULL, true);
3857 page_counter_init(&memcg->swap, NULL, false);
3858#ifdef CONFIG_MEMCG_V1
3859 page_counter_init(&memcg->kmem, NULL, false);
3860 page_counter_init(&memcg->tcpmem, NULL, false);
3861#endif
3862 root_mem_cgroup = memcg;
3863 return &memcg->css;
3864 }
3865
3866 if (memcg_on_dfl && !cgroup_memory_nosocket)
3867 static_branch_inc(&memcg_sockets_enabled_key);
3868
3869 if (!cgroup_memory_nobpf)
3870 static_branch_inc(&memcg_bpf_enabled_key);
3871
3872 return &memcg->css;
3873}

3875static int mem_cgroup_css_online(struct cgroup_subsys_state *css)
3876{
3877 struct mem_cgroup *memcg = mem_cgroup_from_css(css);
3878
3879 if (memcg_online_kmem(memcg))
3880 goto remove_id;
3881
3882 /*
3883 * A memcg must be visible for expand_shrinker_info()
3884 * by the time the maps are allocated. So, we allocate maps
3885 * here, when for_each_mem_cgroup() can't skip it.
3886 */
3887 if (alloc_shrinker_info(memcg))
3888 goto offline_kmem;
3889
3890 if (unlikely(mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg)) && !mem_cgroup_disabled())
3891 queue_delayed_work(system_dfl_wq, &stats_flush_dwork,
3892 FLUSH_TIME);
3893 lru_gen_online_memcg(memcg);
3894
3895 /* Online state pins memcg ID, memcg ID pins CSS */
3896 refcount_set(&memcg->id.ref, 1);
3897 css_get(css);
3898
3899 /*
3900 * Ensure mem_cgroup_from_private_id() works once we're fully online.
3901 *
3902 * We could do this earlier and require callers to filter with
3903 * css_tryget_online(). But right now there are no users that
3904 * need earlier access, and the workingset code relies on the
3905 * cgroup tree linkage (mem_cgroup_get_nr_swap_pages()). So
3906 * publish it here at the end of onlining. This matches the
3907 * regular ID destruction during offlining.
3908 */
3909 xa_store(&mem_cgroup_private_ids, memcg->id.id, memcg, GFP_KERNEL);
3910
3911 return 0;
3912offline_kmem:
3913 memcg_offline_kmem(memcg);
3914remove_id:
3915 mem_cgroup_private_id_remove(memcg);
3916 return -ENOMEM;
3917}

4004
4005struct aggregate_control {
4006 /* pointer to the aggregated (CPU and subtree aggregated) counters */
4007 long *aggregate;
4008 /* pointer to the non-hierarchichal (CPU aggregated) counters */
4009 long *local;
4010 /* pointer to the pending child counters during tree propagation */
4011 long *pending;
4012 /* pointer to the parent's pending counters, could be NULL */
4013 long *ppending;
4014 /* pointer to the percpu counters to be aggregated */
4015 long *cstat;
4016 /* pointer to the percpu counters of the last aggregation*/
4017 long *cstat_prev;
4018 /* size of the above counters */
4019 int size;
4020};
4021
4022static void mem_cgroup_stat_aggregate(struct aggregate_control *ac)
4023{
4024 int i;
4025 long delta, delta_cpu, v;
4026
4027 for (i = 0; i < ac->size; i++) {
4028 /*
4029 * Collect the aggregated propagation counts of groups
4030 * below us. We're in a per-cpu loop here and this is
4031 * a global counter, so the first cycle will get them.
4032 */
4033 delta = ac->pending[i];
4034 if (delta)
4035 ac->pending[i] = 0;
4036
4037 /* Add CPU changes on this level since the last flush */
4038 delta_cpu = 0;
4039 v = READ_ONCE(ac->cstat[i]);
4040 if (v != ac->cstat_prev[i]) {
4041 delta_cpu = v - ac->cstat_prev[i];
4042 delta += delta_cpu;
4043 ac->cstat_prev[i] = v;
4044 }
4045
4046 /* Aggregate counts on this level and propagate upwards */
4047 if (delta_cpu)
4048 ac->local[i] += delta_cpu;
4049
4050 if (delta) {
4051 ac->aggregate[i] += delta;
4052 if (ac->ppending)
4053 ac->ppending[i] += delta;
4054 }
4055 }
4056}
4057
4058#ifdef CONFIG_MEMCG_NMI_SAFETY_REQUIRES_ATOMIC
4059static void flush_nmi_stats(struct mem_cgroup *memcg, struct mem_cgroup *parent,
4060 int cpu)
4061{
4062 int nid;
4063
4064 if (atomic_read(&memcg->kmem_stat)) {
4065 int kmem = atomic_xchg(&memcg->kmem_stat, 0);
4066 int index = memcg_stats_index(MEMCG_KMEM);
4067
4068 memcg->vmstats->state[index] += kmem;
4069 if (parent)
4070 parent->vmstats->state_pending[index] += kmem;
4071 }
4072
4073 for_each_node_state(nid, N_MEMORY) {
4074 struct mem_cgroup_per_node *pn = memcg->nodeinfo[nid];
4075 struct lruvec_stats *lstats = pn->lruvec_stats;
4076 struct lruvec_stats *plstats = NULL;
4077
4078 if (parent)
4079 plstats = parent->nodeinfo[nid]->lruvec_stats;
4080
4081 if (atomic_read(&pn->slab_reclaimable)) {
4082 int slab = atomic_xchg(&pn->slab_reclaimable, 0);
4083 int index = memcg_stats_index(NR_SLAB_RECLAIMABLE_B);
4084
4085 lstats->state[index] += slab;
4086 if (plstats)
4087 plstats->state_pending[index] += slab;
4088 memcg->vmstats->state[index] += slab;
4089 if (parent)
4090 parent->vmstats->state_pending[index] += slab;
4091 }
4092 if (atomic_read(&pn->slab_unreclaimable)) {
4093 int slab = atomic_xchg(&pn->slab_unreclaimable, 0);
4094 int index = memcg_stats_index(NR_SLAB_UNRECLAIMABLE_B);
4095
4096 lstats->state[index] += slab;
4097 if (plstats)
4098 plstats->state_pending[index] += slab;
4099 memcg->vmstats->state[index] += slab;
4100 if (parent)
4101 parent->vmstats->state_pending[index] += slab;
4102 }
4103 }
4104}
4105#else
4106static void flush_nmi_stats(struct mem_cgroup *memcg, struct mem_cgroup *parent,
4107 int cpu)
4108{}
4109#endif
4110
4111static void mem_cgroup_css_rstat_flush(struct cgroup_subsys_state *css, int cpu)
4112{
4113 struct mem_cgroup *memcg = mem_cgroup_from_css(css);
4114 struct mem_cgroup *parent = parent_mem_cgroup(memcg);
4115 struct memcg_vmstats_percpu *statc;
4116 struct aggregate_control ac;
4117 int nid;
4118
4119 flush_nmi_stats(memcg, parent, cpu);
4120
4121 statc = per_cpu_ptr(memcg->vmstats_percpu, cpu);
4122
4123 ac = (struct aggregate_control) {
4124 .aggregate = memcg->vmstats->state,
4125 .local = memcg->vmstats->state_local,
4126 .pending = memcg->vmstats->state_pending,
4127 .ppending = parent ? parent->vmstats->state_pending : NULL,
4128 .cstat = statc->state,
4129 .cstat_prev = statc->state_prev,
4130 .size = MEMCG_VMSTAT_SIZE,
4131 };
4132 mem_cgroup_stat_aggregate(&ac);
4133
4134 ac = (struct aggregate_control) {
4135 .aggregate = memcg->vmstats->events,
4136 .local = memcg->vmstats->events_local,
4137 .pending = memcg->vmstats->events_pending,
4138 .ppending = parent ? parent->vmstats->events_pending : NULL,
4139 .cstat = statc->events,
4140 .cstat_prev = statc->events_prev,
4141 .size = NR_MEMCG_EVENTS,
4142 };
4143 mem_cgroup_stat_aggregate(&ac);
4144
4145 for_each_node_state(nid, N_MEMORY) {
4146 struct mem_cgroup_per_node *pn = memcg->nodeinfo[nid];
4147 struct lruvec_stats *lstats = pn->lruvec_stats;
4148 struct lruvec_stats *plstats = NULL;
4149 struct lruvec_stats_percpu *lstatc;
4150
4151 if (parent)
4152 plstats = parent->nodeinfo[nid]->lruvec_stats;
4153
4154 lstatc = per_cpu_ptr(pn->lruvec_stats_percpu, cpu);
4155
4156 ac = (struct aggregate_control) {
4157 .aggregate = lstats->state,
4158 .local = lstats->state_local,
4159 .pending = lstats->state_pending,
4160 .ppending = plstats ? plstats->state_pending : NULL,
4161 .cstat = lstatc->state,
4162 .cstat_prev = lstatc->state_prev,
4163 .size = NR_MEMCG_NODE_STAT_ITEMS,
4164 };
4165 mem_cgroup_stat_aggregate(&ac);
4166
4167 }
4168 WRITE_ONCE(statc->stats_updates, 0);
4169 /* We are in a per-cpu loop here, only do the atomic write once */
4170 if (atomic_read(&memcg->vmstats->stats_updates))
4171 atomic_set(&memcg->vmstats->stats_updates, 0);
4172}
4173
4174static void mem_cgroup_fork(struct task_struct *task)
4175{
4176 /*
4177 * Set the update flag to cause task->objcg to be initialized lazily
4178 * on the first allocation. It can be done without any synchronization
4179 * because it's always performed on the current task, so does
4180 * current_objcg_update().
4181 */
4182 task->objcg = (struct obj_cgroup *)CURRENT_OBJCG_UPDATE_FLAG;
4183}
4184
4185static void mem_cgroup_exit(struct task_struct *task)
4186{
4187 struct obj_cgroup *objcg = task->objcg;
4188
4189 objcg = (struct obj_cgroup *)
4190 ((unsigned long)objcg & ~CURRENT_OBJCG_UPDATE_FLAG);
4191 obj_cgroup_put(objcg);
4192
4193 /*
4194 * Some kernel allocations can happen after this point,
4195 * but let's ignore them. It can be done without any synchronization
4196 * because it's always performed on the current task, so does
4197 * current_objcg_update().
4198 */
4199 task->objcg = NULL;
4200}
4201
4202#ifdef CONFIG_LRU_GEN
4203static void mem_cgroup_lru_gen_attach(struct cgroup_taskset *tset)
4204{
4205 struct task_struct *task;
4206 struct cgroup_subsys_state *css;
4207
4208 /* find the first leader if there is any */
4209 cgroup_taskset_for_each_leader(task, css, tset)
4210 break;
4211
4212 if (!task)
4213 return;
4214
4215 task_lock(task);
4216 if (task->mm && READ_ONCE(task->mm->owner) == task)
4217 lru_gen_migrate_mm(task->mm);
4218 task_unlock(task);
4219}
4220#else
4221static void mem_cgroup_lru_gen_attach(struct cgroup_taskset *tset) {}
4222#endif /* CONFIG_LRU_GEN */
4223
4224static void mem_cgroup_kmem_attach(struct cgroup_taskset *tset)
4225{
4226 struct task_struct *task;
4227 struct cgroup_subsys_state *css;
4228
4229 cgroup_taskset_for_each(task, css, tset) {
4230 /* atomically set the update bit */
4231 set_bit(CURRENT_OBJCG_UPDATE_BIT, (unsigned long *)&task->objcg);
4232 }
4233}
4234
4235static void mem_cgroup_attach(struct cgroup_taskset *tset)
4236{
4237 mem_cgroup_lru_gen_attach(tset);
4238 mem_cgroup_kmem_attach(tset);
4239}

4259#define OFP_PEAK_UNSET (((-1UL)))
4260
4261static int peak_show(struct seq_file *sf, void *v, struct page_counter *pc)
4262{
4263 struct cgroup_of_peak *ofp = of_peak(sf->private);
4264 u64 fd_peak = READ_ONCE(ofp->value), peak;
4265
4266 /* User wants global or local peak? */
4267 if (fd_peak == OFP_PEAK_UNSET)
4268 peak = pc->watermark;
4269 else
4270 peak = max(fd_peak, READ_ONCE(pc->local_watermark));
4271
4272 seq_printf(sf, "%llu\n", peak * PAGE_SIZE);
4273 return 0;
4274}

4283static int peak_open(struct kernfs_open_file *of)
4284{
4285 struct cgroup_of_peak *ofp = of_peak(of);
4286
4287 ofp->value = OFP_PEAK_UNSET;
4288 return 0;

4291static void peak_release(struct kernfs_open_file *of)
4292{
4293 struct mem_cgroup *memcg = mem_cgroup_from_css(of_css(of));
4294 struct cgroup_of_peak *ofp = of_peak(of);
4295
4296 if (ofp->value == OFP_PEAK_UNSET) {
4297 /* fast path (no writes on this fd) */
4298 return;
4299 }
4300 spin_lock(&memcg->peaks_lock);
4301 list_del(&ofp->list);
4302 spin_unlock(&memcg->peaks_lock);
4303}
4304
4305static ssize_t peak_write(struct kernfs_open_file *of, char *buf, size_t nbytes,
4306 loff_t off, struct page_counter *pc,
4307 struct list_head *watchers)
4308{
4309 unsigned long usage;
4310 struct cgroup_of_peak *peer_ctx;
4311 struct mem_cgroup *memcg = mem_cgroup_from_css(of_css(of));
4312 struct cgroup_of_peak *ofp = of_peak(of);
4313
4314 spin_lock(&memcg->peaks_lock);
4315
4316 usage = page_counter_read(pc);
4317 WRITE_ONCE(pc->local_watermark, usage);
4318
4319 list_for_each_entry(peer_ctx, watchers, list)
4320 if (usage > peer_ctx->value)
4321 WRITE_ONCE(peer_ctx->value, usage);
4322
4323 /* initial write, register watcher */
4324 if (ofp->value == OFP_PEAK_UNSET)
4325 list_add(&ofp->list, watchers);
4326
4327 WRITE_ONCE(ofp->value, usage);
4328 spin_unlock(&memcg->peaks_lock);
4329
4330 return nbytes;
4331}
4332
4333static ssize_t memory_peak_write(struct kernfs_open_file *of, char *buf,
4334 size_t nbytes, loff_t off)
4335{
4336 struct mem_cgroup *memcg = mem_cgroup_from_css(of_css(of));
4337
4338 return peak_write(of, buf, nbytes, off, &memcg->memory,
4339 &memcg->memory_peaks);
4340}

4342#undef OFP_PEAK_UNSET

4396static ssize_t memory_high_write(struct kernfs_open_file *of,
4397 char *buf, size_t nbytes, loff_t off)
4398{
4399 struct mem_cgroup *memcg = mem_cgroup_from_css(of_css(of));
4400 unsigned int nr_retries = MAX_RECLAIM_RETRIES;
4401 bool drained = false;
4402 unsigned long high;
4403 int err;
4404
4405 buf = strstrip(buf);
4406 err = page_counter_memparse(buf, "max", &high);
4407 if (err)
4408 return err;
4409
4410 page_counter_set_high(&memcg->memory, high);
4411
4412 if (of->file->f_flags & O_NONBLOCK)
4413 goto out;
4414
4415 for (;;) {
4416 unsigned long nr_pages = page_counter_read(&memcg->memory);
4417 unsigned long reclaimed;
4418
4419 if (nr_pages <= high)
4420 break;
4421
4422 if (signal_pending(current))
4423 break;
4424
4425 if (!drained) {
4426 drain_all_stock(memcg);
4427 drained = true;
4428 continue;
4429 }
4430
4431 reclaimed = try_to_free_mem_cgroup_pages(memcg, nr_pages - high,
4432 GFP_KERNEL, MEMCG_RECLAIM_MAY_SWAP, NULL);
4433
4434 if (!reclaimed && !nr_retries--)
4435 break;
4436 }
4437out:
4438 memcg_wb_domain_size_changed(memcg);
4439 return nbytes;
4440}
4441
4442static int memory_max_show(struct seq_file *m, void *v)
4443{
4444 return seq_puts_memcg_tunable(m,
4445 READ_ONCE(mem_cgroup_from_seq(m)->memory.max));
4446}

4448static ssize_t memory_max_write(struct kernfs_open_file *of,
4449 char *buf, size_t nbytes, loff_t off)
4450{
4451 struct mem_cgroup *memcg = mem_cgroup_from_css(of_css(of));
4452 unsigned int nr_reclaims = MAX_RECLAIM_RETRIES;
4453 bool drained = false;
4454 unsigned long max;
4455 int err;
4456
4457 buf = strstrip(buf);
4458 err = page_counter_memparse(buf, "max", &max);
4459 if (err)
4460 return err;
4461
4462 xchg(&memcg->memory.max, max);
4463
4464 if (of->file->f_flags & O_NONBLOCK)
4465 goto out;
4466
4467 for (;;) {
4468 unsigned long nr_pages = page_counter_read(&memcg->memory);
4469
4470 if (nr_pages <= max)
4471 break;
4472
4473 if (signal_pending(current))
4474 break;
4475
4476 if (!drained) {
4477 drain_all_stock(memcg);
4478 drained = true;
4479 continue;
4480 }
4481
4482 if (nr_reclaims) {
4483 if (!try_to_free_mem_cgroup_pages(memcg, nr_pages - max,
4484 GFP_KERNEL, MEMCG_RECLAIM_MAY_SWAP, NULL))
4485 nr_reclaims--;
4486 continue;
4487 }
4488
4489 memcg_memory_event(memcg, MEMCG_OOM);
4490 if (!mem_cgroup_out_of_memory(memcg, GFP_KERNEL, 0))
4491 break;
4492 cond_resched();
4493 }
4494out:
4495 memcg_wb_domain_size_changed(memcg);
4496 return nbytes;
4497}

4785int mem_cgroup_charge_hugetlb(struct folio *folio, gfp_t gfp)
4786{

4788 int ret = 0;

4790 /*
4791 * Even memcg does not account for hugetlb, we still want to update
4792 * system-level stats via lruvec_stat_mod_folio. Return 0, and skip
4793 * charging the memcg.
4794 */
4795 if (mem_cgroup_disabled() || !memcg_accounts_hugetlb() ||
4796 !memcg || !cgroup_subsys_on_dfl(memory_cgrp_subsys))
4797 goto out;

4800 ret = -ENOMEM;
4801
4802out:

4805}

4842struct uncharge_gather {
4843 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
4844 unsigned long nr_memory;
4845 unsigned long pgpgout;
4846 unsigned long nr_kmem;
4847 int nid;
4848};
4849
4850static inline void uncharge_gather_clear(struct uncharge_gather *ug)
4851{
4852 memset(ug, 0, sizeof(*ug));
4853}
4854
4855static void uncharge_batch(const struct uncharge_gather *ug)
4856{
4857 if (ug->nr_memory) {
4858 memcg_uncharge(ug->memcg, ug->nr_memory);
4859 if (ug->nr_kmem) {
4860 mod_memcg_state(ug->memcg, MEMCG_KMEM, -ug->nr_kmem);
4861 memcg1_account_kmem(ug->memcg, -ug->nr_kmem);
4862 }
4863 memcg1_oom_recover(ug->memcg);
4864 }
4865
4866 memcg1_uncharge_batch(ug->memcg, ug->pgpgout, ug->nr_memory, ug->nid);
4867
4868 /* drop reference from uncharge_folio */
4869 css_put(&ug->memcg->css);
4870}
4871
4872static void uncharge_folio(struct folio *folio, struct uncharge_gather *ug)
4873{
4874 long nr_pages;
4875 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
4876 struct obj_cgroup *objcg;
4877
4878 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(folio_test_lru(folio), folio);
4879
4880 /*
4881 * Nobody should be changing or seriously looking at
4882 * folio memcg or objcg at this point, we have fully
4883 * exclusive access to the folio.
4884 */
4885 if (folio_memcg_kmem(folio)) {
4886 objcg = __folio_objcg(folio);
4887 /*
4888 * This get matches the put at the end of the function and
4889 * kmem pages do not hold memcg references anymore.
4890 */
4891 memcg = get_mem_cgroup_from_objcg(objcg);
4892 } else {
4893 memcg = __folio_memcg(folio);
4894 }
4895
4896 if (!memcg)
4897 return;
4898
4899 if (ug->memcg != memcg) {
4900 if (ug->memcg) {
4901 uncharge_batch(ug);
4902 uncharge_gather_clear(ug);
4903 }
4904 ug->memcg = memcg;
4905 ug->nid = folio_nid(folio);
4906
4907 /* pairs with css_put in uncharge_batch */
4908 css_get(&memcg->css);
4909 }
4910
4911 nr_pages = folio_nr_pages(folio);
4912
4913 if (folio_memcg_kmem(folio)) {
4914 ug->nr_memory += nr_pages;
4915 ug->nr_kmem += nr_pages;
4916
4917 folio->memcg_data = 0;
4918 obj_cgroup_put(objcg);
4919 } else {
4920 /* LRU pages aren't accounted at the root level */
4921 if (!mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg))
4922 ug->nr_memory += nr_pages;
4923 ug->pgpgout++;
4924
4925 WARN_ON_ONCE(folio_unqueue_deferred_split(folio));
4926 folio->memcg_data = 0;
4927 }
4928
4929 css_put(&memcg->css);
4930}
4931
4932void __mem_cgroup_uncharge(struct folio *folio)
4933{
4934 struct uncharge_gather ug;
4935
4936 /* Don't touch folio->lru of any random page, pre-check: */
4937 if (!folio_memcg_charged(folio))
4938 return;
4939
4940 uncharge_gather_clear(&ug);
4941 uncharge_folio(folio, &ug);
4942 uncharge_batch(&ug);
4943}
4944
4945void __mem_cgroup_uncharge_folios(struct folio_batch *folios)
4946{
4947 struct uncharge_gather ug;
4948 unsigned int i;
4949
4950 uncharge_gather_clear(&ug);
4951 for (i = 0; i < folios->nr; i++)
4952 uncharge_folio(folios->folios[i], &ug);
4953 if (ug.memcg)
4954 uncharge_batch(&ug);
4955}

4967void mem_cgroup_replace_folio(struct folio *old, struct folio *new)
4968{
4969 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
4970 long nr_pages = folio_nr_pages(new);
4971
4972 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(!folio_test_locked(old), old);
4973 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(!folio_test_locked(new), new);
4974 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(folio_test_anon(old) != folio_test_anon(new), new);
4975 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(folio_nr_pages(old) != nr_pages, new);
4976
4977 if (mem_cgroup_disabled())
4978 return;
4979
4980 /* Page cache replacement: new folio already charged? */
4981 if (folio_memcg_charged(new))
4982 return;
4983
4984 memcg = folio_memcg(old);
4985 VM_WARN_ON_ONCE_FOLIO(!memcg, old);
4986 if (!memcg)
4987 return;
4988
4989 /* Force-charge the new page. The old one will be freed soon */
4990 if (!mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg)) {
4991 page_counter_charge(&memcg->memory, nr_pages);
4992 if (do_memsw_account())
4993 page_counter_charge(&memcg->memsw, nr_pages);
4994 }
4995
4996 css_get(&memcg->css);
4997 commit_charge(new, memcg);
4998 memcg1_commit_charge(new, memcg);
4999}
5000
5012void mem_cgroup_migrate(struct folio *old, struct folio *new)
5013{
5014 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
5015
5016 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(!folio_test_locked(old), old);
5017 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(!folio_test_locked(new), new);
5018 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(folio_test_anon(old) != folio_test_anon(new), new);
5019 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(folio_nr_pages(old) != folio_nr_pages(new), new);
5020 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(folio_test_lru(old), old);
5021
5022 if (mem_cgroup_disabled())
5023 return;
5024
5025 memcg = folio_memcg(old);
5026 /*
5027 * Note that it is normal to see !memcg for a hugetlb folio.
5028 * For e.g, it could have been allocated when memory_hugetlb_accounting
5029 * was not selected.
5030 */
5031 VM_WARN_ON_ONCE_FOLIO(!folio_test_hugetlb(old) && !memcg, old);
5032 if (!memcg)
5033 return;
5034
5035 /* Transfer the charge and the css ref */
5036 commit_charge(new, memcg);
5037
5038 /* Warning should never happen, so don't worry about refcount non-0 */
5039 WARN_ON_ONCE(folio_unqueue_deferred_split(old));
5040 old->memcg_data = 0;
5041}

5046void mem_cgroup_sk_alloc(struct sock *sk)
5047{
5048 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
5049
5050 if (!mem_cgroup_sockets_enabled)
5051 return;
5052
5053 /* Do not associate the sock with unrelated interrupted task's memcg. */
5054 if (!in_task())
5055 return;
5056
5057 rcu_read_lock();
5058 memcg = mem_cgroup_from_task(current);
5059 if (mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg))
5060 goto out;
5061 if (!cgroup_subsys_on_dfl(memory_cgrp_subsys) && !memcg1_tcpmem_active(memcg))
5062 goto out;
5063 if (css_tryget(&memcg->css))
5064 sk->sk_memcg = memcg;
5065out:
5066 rcu_read_unlock();
5067}

5077void mem_cgroup_sk_inherit(const struct sock *sk, struct sock *newsk)
5078{

5082 return;
5083
5084 mem_cgroup_sk_free(newsk);
5085
5086 memcg = mem_cgroup_from_sk(sk);
5087 if (memcg)
5088 css_get(&memcg->css);
5089
5090 newsk->sk_memcg = sk->sk_memcg;
5091}

5102bool mem_cgroup_sk_charge(const struct sock *sk, unsigned int nr_pages,
5103 gfp_t gfp_mask)
5104{
5105 struct mem_cgroup *memcg = mem_cgroup_from_sk(sk);
5106
5107 if (!cgroup_subsys_on_dfl(memory_cgrp_subsys))
5108 return memcg1_charge_skmem(memcg, nr_pages, gfp_mask);
5109
5110 if (try_charge_memcg(memcg, gfp_mask, nr_pages) == 0) {
5111 mod_memcg_state(memcg, MEMCG_SOCK, nr_pages);
5112 return true;
5113 }
5114
5115 return false;
5116}

5160/*
5161 * Memory controller init before cgroup_init() initialize root_mem_cgroup.
5162 *
5163 * Some parts like memcg_hotplug_cpu_dead() have to be initialized from this
5164 * context because of lock dependencies (cgroup_lock -> cpu hotplug) but
5165 * basically everything that doesn't depend on a specific mem_cgroup structure
5166 * should be initialized from here.
5167 */
5168int __init mem_cgroup_init(void)
5169{
5170 unsigned int memcg_size;
5171 int cpu;
5172
5173 /*
5174 * Currently s32 type (can refer to struct batched_lruvec_stat) is
5175 * used for per-memcg-per-cpu caching of per-node statistics. In order
5176 * to work fine, we should make sure that the overfill threshold can't
5177 * exceed S32_MAX / PAGE_SIZE.
5178 */
5179 BUILD_BUG_ON(MEMCG_CHARGE_BATCH > S32_MAX / PAGE_SIZE);
5180
5181 cpuhp_setup_state_nocalls(CPUHP_MM_MEMCQ_DEAD, "mm/memctrl:dead", NULL,
5182 memcg_hotplug_cpu_dead);
5183
5184 memcg_wq = alloc_workqueue("memcg", WQ_PERCPU, 0);
5185 WARN_ON(!memcg_wq);
5186
5187 for_each_possible_cpu(cpu) {
5188 INIT_WORK(&per_cpu_ptr(&memcg_stock, cpu)->work,
5189 drain_local_memcg_stock);
5190 INIT_WORK(&per_cpu_ptr(&obj_stock, cpu)->work,
5191 drain_local_obj_stock);
5192 }
5193
5194 memcg_size = struct_size_t(struct mem_cgroup, nodeinfo, nr_node_ids);
5195 memcg_cachep = kmem_cache_create("mem_cgroup", memcg_size, 0,
5196 SLAB_PANIC | SLAB_HWCACHE_ALIGN, NULL);
5197
5198 memcg_pn_cachep = KMEM_CACHE(mem_cgroup_per_node,
5199 SLAB_PANIC | SLAB_HWCACHE_ALIGN);
5200
5201 return 0;
5202}

5204#ifdef CONFIG_SWAP
5214int __mem_cgroup_try_charge_swap(struct folio *folio, swp_entry_t entry)
5215{
5216 unsigned int nr_pages = folio_nr_pages(folio);
5217 struct page_counter *counter;
5218 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
5219
5220 if (do_memsw_account())
5221 return 0;
5222
5223 memcg = folio_memcg(folio);
5224
5225 VM_WARN_ON_ONCE_FOLIO(!memcg, folio);
5226 if (!memcg)
5227 return 0;
5228
5229 if (!entry.val) {
5230 memcg_memory_event(memcg, MEMCG_SWAP_FAIL);
5231 return 0;
5232 }
5233
5234 memcg = mem_cgroup_private_id_get_online(memcg);
5235
5236 if (!mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg) &&
5237 !page_counter_try_charge(&memcg->swap, nr_pages, &counter)) {
5238 memcg_memory_event(memcg, MEMCG_SWAP_MAX);
5239 memcg_memory_event(memcg, MEMCG_SWAP_FAIL);
5240 mem_cgroup_private_id_put(memcg);
5241 return -ENOMEM;
5242 }
5243
5244 /* Get references for the tail pages, too */
5245 if (nr_pages > 1)
5246 mem_cgroup_private_id_get_many(memcg, nr_pages - 1);
5247 mod_memcg_state(memcg, MEMCG_SWAP, nr_pages);
5248
5249 swap_cgroup_record(folio, mem_cgroup_private_id(memcg), entry);
5250
5251 return 0;
5252}
5253
5259void __mem_cgroup_uncharge_swap(swp_entry_t entry, unsigned int nr_pages)
5260{
5261 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
5262 unsigned short id;
5263
5264 id = swap_cgroup_clear(entry, nr_pages);
5265 rcu_read_lock();
5266 memcg = mem_cgroup_from_private_id(id);
5267 if (memcg) {
5268 if (!mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg)) {
5269 if (do_memsw_account())
5270 page_counter_uncharge(&memcg->memsw, nr_pages);
5271 else
5272 page_counter_uncharge(&memcg->swap, nr_pages);
5273 }
5274 mod_memcg_state(memcg, MEMCG_SWAP, -nr_pages);
5275 mem_cgroup_private_id_put_many(memcg, nr_pages);
5276 }
5277 rcu_read_unlock();
5278}

5280long mem_cgroup_get_nr_swap_pages(struct mem_cgroup *memcg)
5281{
5282 long nr_swap_pages = get_nr_swap_pages();
5283
5284 if (mem_cgroup_disabled() || do_memsw_account())
5285 return nr_swap_pages;
5286 for (; !mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg); memcg = parent_mem_cgroup(memcg))
5287 nr_swap_pages = min_t(long, nr_swap_pages,
5288 READ_ONCE(memcg->swap.max) -
5289 page_counter_read(&memcg->swap));
5290 return nr_swap_pages;
5291}
5292
5293bool mem_cgroup_swap_full(struct folio *folio)
5294{
5295 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
5296
5297 VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO(!folio_test_locked(folio), folio);
5298
5299 if (vm_swap_full())
5300 return true;
5301 if (do_memsw_account())
5302 return false;
5303
5304 memcg = folio_memcg(folio);
5305 if (!memcg)
5306 return false;
5307
5308 for (; !mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg); memcg = parent_mem_cgroup(memcg)) {
5309 unsigned long usage = page_counter_read(&memcg->swap);
5310
5311 if (usage * 2 >= READ_ONCE(memcg->swap.high) ||
5312 usage * 2 >= READ_ONCE(memcg->swap.max))
5313 return true;
5314 }
5315
5316 return false;
5317}

5451#ifdef CONFIG_ZSWAP
5464bool obj_cgroup_may_zswap(struct obj_cgroup *objcg)
5465{
5466 struct mem_cgroup *memcg, *original_memcg;
5467 bool ret = true;
5468
5469 if (!cgroup_subsys_on_dfl(memory_cgrp_subsys))
5470 return true;
5471
5472 original_memcg = get_mem_cgroup_from_objcg(objcg);
5473 for (memcg = original_memcg; !mem_cgroup_is_root(memcg);
5474 memcg = parent_mem_cgroup(memcg)) {
5475 unsigned long max = READ_ONCE(memcg->zswap_max);
5476 unsigned long pages;
5477
5478 if (max == PAGE_COUNTER_MAX)
5479 continue;
5480 if (max == 0) {
5481 ret = false;
5482 break;
5483 }
5484
5485 /* Force flush to get accurate stats for charging */
5486 __mem_cgroup_flush_stats(memcg, true);
5487 pages = memcg_page_state(memcg, MEMCG_ZSWAP_B) / PAGE_SIZE;
5488 if (pages < max)
5489 continue;
5490 ret = false;
5491 break;
5492 }
5493 mem_cgroup_put(original_memcg);
5494 return ret;
5495}

5505void obj_cgroup_charge_zswap(struct obj_cgroup *objcg, size_t size)
5506{
5507 struct mem_cgroup *memcg;
5508
5509 if (!cgroup_subsys_on_dfl(memory_cgrp_subsys))
5510 return;
5511
5512 VM_WARN_ON_ONCE(!(current->flags & PF_MEMALLOC));
5513
5514 /* PF_MEMALLOC context, charging must succeed */
5515 if (obj_cgroup_charge(objcg, GFP_KERNEL, size))
5516 VM_WARN_ON_ONCE(1);
5517
5518 rcu_read_lock();
5519 memcg = obj_cgroup_memcg(objcg);
5520 mod_memcg_state(memcg, MEMCG_ZSWAP_B, size);
5521 mod_memcg_state(memcg, MEMCG_ZSWAPPED, 1);
5522 rcu_read_unlock();
5523}

5657void mem_cgroup_node_filter_allowed(struct mem_cgroup *memcg, nodemask_t *mask)
5658{
5659 nodemask_t allowed;
5660
5661 if (!memcg)
5662 return;
5663
5664 /*
5665 * Since this interface is intended for use by migration paths, and
5666 * reclaim and migration are subject to race conditions such as changes
5667 * in effective_mems and hot-unpluging of nodes, inaccurate allowed
5668 * mask is acceptable.
5669 */
5670 cpuset_nodes_allowed(memcg->css.cgroup, &allowed);
5671 nodes_and(*mask, *mask, allowed);
5672}
5673
5674void mem_cgroup_show_protected_memory(struct mem_cgroup *memcg)
5675{
5676 if (mem_cgroup_disabled() || !cgroup_subsys_on_dfl(memory_cgrp_subsys))
5677 return;
5678
5679 if (!memcg)
5680 memcg = root_mem_cgroup;
5681
5682 pr_warn("Memory cgroup min protection %lukB -- low protection %lukB",
5683 K(atomic_long_read(&memcg->memory.children_min_usage)),
5684 K(atomic_long_read(&memcg->memory.children_low_usage)));
5685}
